search.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Independent identifier, label and unmatched queries were executed; their live counts and result rows are retained.

facets.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Property-filter selection, combination with search and reset were independently exercised.

result_counts.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Observed counts respond to queries and facets and are distinct from the total.

sorting.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Each available sort option was selected, with URL/control state and first result rows retained.

shareable_state.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. A combined query/filter/sort view was reloaded and its controls and matching count compared.

full_catalogue.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. The total is backed by linked listings/category pagination or complete indexed corpus; search-result caps are assessed separately.

record_pages.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Multiple stable individual record URLs opened successfully from a fresh browser navigation.

term_links.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Attachment organelle membrane now has named Subject/Object GO:0033111, GO:0033099 and GO:0005886 resolver anchors, including the mechanism table; the old unlinked-section reason is no longer true.

evidence.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Sampled record references include working-format PMID/DOI/source URL anchors rather than only database navigation.

review_status.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Sampled record headers explicitly state their workflow state.

curation_history.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Sampled records show dated curation-event sections with attribution and action text.

source_link.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Sampled record pages link their own YAML source file rather than just the repository root.

domain_view.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. The valid embedding-map.html and sequence-map.html routes render; the obsolete map.html URL is not the current linked text map.

cross_mech_links.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Sampled record content includes a direct link to a specific sibling record; navigation links were excluded.

corpus_stats.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. The generated landing figures were read from the browser and compared with the audited corpus counts.

category_browse.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Landing links lead into distinct category subsets with continuation where needed.

suite_nav.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Visible suite-directory links occur in the reviewed navigation or footer.

downloads.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. The linked corpus.json is distinct from index.json and contains complete structure records with components, taxonomic_distribution, evidence, causal_graphs and curation_history.

schema_docs.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Visible schema links reach raw LinkML YAML; consistent fleet arbitration requires partial when rendered schema documentation is not provided.

license.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Reviewed landing, browser, records and maps distinguish CC BY data from BSD code.

build_provenance.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. The footer explicitly dates its own corpus 2026-11-03 05:55:11 UTC and identifies digest d7c5fef867d9 and 1022 records.

theme_toggle.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Dark was selected and independently carried across the valid reviewed routes.

responsive.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Every valid reviewed route was checked at fresh and resized 390px; none exceeded the viewport.

load_failure.rationale: Fresh browser check and independently verified review-only diff preserve the prior criterion judgment. Relevant data requests were aborted and the resulting reader-facing error was inspected.

Browse · Envelope · S-layer

S-layer

GO:0030115 · Envelope · Envelope layer · Proposed

A paracrystalline monomolecular array of one or more (glyco)protein species that self-assemble on the outermost surface of the cell envelope, with oblique, square or hexagonal lattice symmetry. S-layers are common in Archaea, where they are often the sole wall component, and widespread but patchily distributed in Bacteria. [DOI:10.1111/1574-6976.12063]

Image (not hosted — CC_BY_NC_4_0): CaltechDATA qgffm-kzf88 (Atlas of Bacterial and Archaeal Cell Structure, 2.6 Surface layer, file 2_6_Ccrescentus.mp4)

Electron cryotomogram video of a Caulobacter crescentus cell; the Atlas section shows the paracrystalline S-layer outside the outer membrane. CRYO_ET · Caulobacter vibrioides (NCBITaxon:155892) · Catherine Oikon

cellstructuremech:stentor_myoneme_system · Cytoskeleton · Other · Proposed

The cortical system of longitudinal contractile filament bundles, historically termed M bands, characterized in Stentor coeruleus. Its prominent posterior myonemes are distinct from the adjacent microtubular Km fibers; this record does not denote every centrin-containing cortical assembly. [DOI:10.1126/science.177.4047.447]
